title: RAID CORNER MONEY BLOCK IS COMPACT
why: His order: the raid corner takes way too much of the screen, make it much more compact. The four money plates become one short plate with two lines of figures, about a third of the height; the minimap and the panels under it move up with it.
now: The raid corner shows money, xp, stash and backpack on two short lines in one plate instead of four tall plates.

edits.replacement: g.n=(n+1)>>1; g.bw=trBW(); g.ls=LH(13)+3; g.rh=16+LH(13)+(g.n>0?g.n-1:0)*g.ls; g.x=W-16-g.bw;   // v33.xx (cw-cornercompact), HIS ORDER (2026-10-20): "this takes up way too much of the screen, figure out how to make it much more compact". The four plates are ONE plate now: figures in two columns on short lines (n is the lines, rh the plate's height), about a third of the old block
var g=TRG, y=g.y0, by=y+8+LH(8)+(i>>1)*g.ls, cw=(g.bw-28)/2, cx=g.x+8+(i&1)*(cw+12);   // v33.xx (cw-cornercompact): cell i sits on line i>>1, left or right half
